open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings
open_points.text: A missing, malformed or inconsistent value (a wildcard host or origin, binary bounds out of order) stops the start.
open_points.question: When a validation failure occurs during the newly added post-start call at each binary read, what exact exception type and payload does load_runtime_settings expose to binary_storage, and are missing, malformed and inconsistent values distinguished?
options: Raise one dedicated typed runtime-settings exception for every validation failure, with a structured reason
Raise different typed exceptions for missing, malformed and inconsistent values
Expose built-in parsing or validation exceptions directly
open_points.default_guess: Raise one dedicated typed runtime-settings exception with a structured failure reason, which binary_storage translates to BinaryStorageError.

witness.initial: The service started with a valid environment; afterward BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES becomes malformed before an authorized binary read.
events: binary_storage calls load_runtime_settings for that read
load_runtime_settings reads and validates the changed environment
outcomes: One implementation raises a dedicated runtime-settings exception carrying a validation reason
Another implementation exposes a built-in integer-conversion exception
witness.observer: module:binary_storage, which must know what failure to catch and translate
